title: Chicago Made A River Flow Backwards 🌊
caption:
This city made a river flow BACKWARDS 🌊
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. Chicago's sewage flowed into Lake Michigan, its drinking water. In 1900 engineers opened the Sanitary and Ship Canal and reversed the Chicago River to send the sewage away toward the Mississippi. Downstream Missouri sued, and lost in 1906.
Genius engineering or just moving the problem? 👇
first_comment: Chicago solved its sewage problem by sending it downstream. Genius or petty? 🌊👇
